subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should non-internal room_event turns keep strict message-tool-only delivery while only stabilizing cache-sensitive prompt text, or should explicit groupChat.visibleReplies automatic change room-event visible delivery semantics?
rationale: Current code, docs, and tests intentionally keep ambient room events private, but the report shows a credible prompt-cache and instruction-consistency regression that cannot be solved safely without choosing the privacy and prompt-cache contract.

options.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
options.body: Keep room_event visible output message-tool-only by default, but make cache-sensitive prompt sections follow a session-stable mode and keep strictness in current-turn context below the cache boundary.

options.title: Honor Automatic For Room Events
options.body: Let explicit groupChat.visibleReplies automatic make room_event final text visible, with privacy-focused docs and regression tests for ambient rooms.

options.title: Document Strict Cache Tradeoff
options.body: Treat strict room-event delivery as intended and resolve this by documenting the prompt/cache tradeoff clearly for operators.

recommendation.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
recommendation.body: Keep room_event visible output message-tool-only by default, but make cache-sensitive prompt sections follow a session-stable mode and keep strictness in current-turn context below the cache boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room product contract introduced by the prior merged policy work.
